note: SEC-01. Every entry is a route that manufactures a business fact under a permission name no shipped role names. This list may only SHRINK: a new one fails the build, and a fixed one must be deleted from here or the test says so. History of the number, because it moved for two different reasons: 419 recorded at stage 2 (2026-09-18); J1-07 removed 6 by declaring crm.requirement.* / crm.scope.* / crm.quotation.create on the pre-award discovery routes; then 4 MORE were ADDED here - not new debt, but debt the scan had been hiding. Mutation-testing this guard during J1-07 showed the scanner treated a handler as governed when its NEIGHBOUR declared @Permissions below its own @Post, so every earlier count was a floor. The true stage-2 number was 423, not 419. Governing-verb routes: 66 before J1-07, 65 after it, 63 after the finance period close and reopen, 60 after the subcontractor claim certification, variation decision and back-charge recovery, 56 after customer invoicing, 53 after the procurement commitments, 40 at the end of wave A (tendering, HR and contracts), and 32 at the end of wave B (hse). Two TOMBSTONES also left the list: PATCH procurement/rfqs/:id/award and PATCH procurement/purchase-orders/:id/status are handlers declared `(): never` that exist only to refuse and say where the act went, so they manufacture no business fact and counting them as debt overstated it by two, one of them a governing verb. WAVE C: 284 mutating ungoverned ROUTES, of which 25 are governing-verb ROUTES carrying 23 distinct NAMES. The two units differ because `crm.opportunity.freeze` is reached by three routes; `governingVerbs` here is the ROUTE count, which is what governed-routes.fitness.test.ts compares, while the audit script prints the NAME count.
